summary: Appends a new 12-byte node to a doubly linked list whose head lives at this. Allocates the node with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12), stores the caller value a2 at node+0 and a byte flag a3 at node+8, links node+4 to the current last node, updates the list head (offset 0x0), seeds offsets 0x4/0x8 when the list was empty, increments the count at offset 0xC, and returns 1. Returns 0 when a2 is null.

On allocation failure set v5 to 0 so the subsequent link writes are suppressed.
Initialize the new node: node[0] = a2, node[4] = 0, node[8] = a3 (byte).
Branch on *this (offset 0x0): when the list is non-empty, link node[4] to the previous last node.
When the list was empty, set both this[1] (offset 0x4) and this[2] (offset 0x8) to the new node.
Write the new node to the list head *this (offset 0x0) so it becomes the last node.
Increment the element count this[3] at offset 0xC.
Return 1 on successful insertion, 0 when a2 was null.
